manual_review_items: RRDataset: independently recheck the CC BY 4.0 dataset license on the official Zenodo record before upload; the record/API was inaccessible during this preparation. The MIT repository license is for code, not dataset imagery.
RRDataset: complete the official paper author list, formal citation and dataset DOI from the linked publisher/Zenodo records; no bibliographic fields were fabricated.
SensiFake: add the curator-approved author list, public release URL and DOI if one is assigned; these identifiers are not yet provided.

Original image attribution: collection manifests do not preserve complete photographer/underlying image-license notices. Verify any additional original-source credit obligations before public redistribution; dataset-level references and source paths are retained.
